name: Orihara Hitomi
source:
Hobbies: Cooking
Likes: Taking walks (mostly in parks)
Dislikes: Maths
A student at St. Julian Girls' Academy.
She was born with a weak constitution and often collapses and is taken to the infirmary.
She has a crush on her math teacher, Azuma, but is unable to express her feelings to him.
